description: Turn your Android device into a locked-down web page in fullscreen mode. Webview Kiosk is a free and open-source Android application for secure, kiosk-style web browsing. It can function as digital signage, a kid-friendly restricted browser, an immersive web reader, an interactive sign-up form, a home assistant dashboard, or simply a wall clock. Designed for small businesses and device owners who are looking for a simple and standalone Kiosk solution. Key Features Core / Standalone - Lock Task Mode (Pin): prevent access to your device's home screen, apps and status bar - Secure Settings: configurations are protected by biometrics, device credentials or custom password - URL Filtering: use regular expressions to control web access through a URL blacklist and whitelist - Export/Import: backup and restore user settings in Base64 or JSON format - Local files: display images, audio, video, HTML or PDF (using Mozilla's PDF.js) in kiosk mode - Default Launcher: use as the home app and launch other apps in lock task mode (kiosk) - JS Scripts: supports NFC (Near Field Communication), Eruda console, Dark Reader and custom scripts - Adblock: blocks ads and trackers using rules from uBlock Origin, AdGuard, EasyList and HaGeZi Remote Management / Enterprise 1. MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) - Monitor events, update settings, execute commands and build custom automations - Requires an MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, or their HomeAssistant integrations) 2. UnifiedPush - Send commands and update settings via a decentralised push notification system - Requires a distributor application (e.g. sunup, ntfy, gCompat-UP) 3. Managed Configurations (App Restrictions) - For fully-managed (company-owned) devices, settings can be configured via an MDM/EMM provider - Advanced users with a device policy controller (e.g. Test DPC or OwnDroid) can also enforce configurations locally For more details, visit https://webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk Permissions - INTERNET: general web browsing - ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: refresh web pages when network connectivity is restored - ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK: (optional, Android 17+) web apps needing LAN - CAMERA: (optional) web apps requiring photo/video capture - RECORD_AUDIO: (optional) web apps requiring audio capture - MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS: routing audio - needed for microphone - ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION: (optional) web apps requiring precise geolocation - ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION: (optional) web apps requiring approximate geolocation - NFC: read/write NFC tags using hardware - VIBRATE: (optional) web apps requiring navigator.vibrate(pattern) - INSTALL_SHORTCUT: home screen launcher shortcuts on Android 7.1 and below - QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: find launchable apps, device owners and lock task packages - POST_NOTIFICATIONS: (optional) for lock task mode launches and MQTT - FOREGROUND_SERVICE: persistent notification for required services - FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: return mechanism after opening apps in kiosk - FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK: background audio/video streaming, e.g. YouTube - USE_BIOMETRIC: replaces USE_FINGERPRINT from Android 9.0 onwards - USE_FINGERPRINT: fingerprint hardware for authentication - WAKE_LOCK: (optional) wake screen when receiving MQTT commands - WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: download files in Android 9.0 and below - API (Dhizuku): request shared owner privileges - API_23 (Shizuku): auto-activate device/profile owner Contact - https://github.com/nktnet1/webview-kiosk - support@webviewkiosk.nktnet.uk Alternatives - Fully Kiosk Browser Lockdown (feature-rich, but not a free kiosk solution) - Web Kiosk (by Screenlite) - FreeKiosk (by Rushb-fr) -
